name: round 2: Wallet alerts, every token
tests: registers Round 2 commands, update types and tick counters
watches survive restarts, escape labels and can be removed by address or label
honours the configured watch cap without consuming slots on duplicates
the default watch cap is 20 and labels longer than 32 characters are refused
whale thresholds cap at five, update in place and validate exact decimal amounts
invalid addresses and track hashes leave subscriptions unchanged
group settings require an administrator while list and Round 1 lookups remain public
creator and anonymous group administrators can configure watches
rate limits use message.date, notify once and recover after 60 seconds
Remove callbacks are short, acknowledged and cannot be used from a different chat
group Remove callbacks recheck the clicking user administrator status
private pasted addresses and hashes offer working Watch and Track buttons
first startup and a newly created watch never backfill old events
one chain-wide filter pages all events and bounds each pass by CAIRN_MAX_BLOCKS
the default catch-up limit is 500 blocks and later passes finish the backlog
modern and legacy transfers aggregate by transaction with exact u256 amounts and directions
identical events at different receipt indexes remain distinct and transactions stay in chain order
tokens outside the registry decode short strings and ByteArrays and are plainly unverified
invalid metadata and NFT-shaped events are ignored without hiding valid ERC-20 events
token metadata is cached across restarts and refreshed after seven days of chain time
zero transfers and the final STRK sequencer fee are suppressed but other transfers remain
watch minimums and mutes are chat-local and unmute restores alerts
whales accept token addresses, include threshold equality and label mints and burns
modern and legacy approvals show the owner, spender and unlimited boundary
balance accepts any token and includes nonzero tokens seen after a watch began
tracks emit L2 then L1 exactly once and report escaped reverts
tracks cap at ten and unknown hashes expire at 600 seconds of chain time
export is complete and forget removes chat data without affecting other chats
Telegram migration moves subscriptions and retries the alert to the new chat id
403 pauses a chat and a new message resumes its pending alerts
membership left or kicked pauses alerts until the bot is re-added
a kill before Telegram acceptance retains pending alerts for restart
confirmed alerts survive a kill and restart without being sent again
a failed continuation page preserves the cursor and retries the entire range
invalid continuation tokens restart safely without duplicating the earlier page
Round 2 numeric configuration is validated before contacting either API
